outcome: achievement of exclusive breastfeeding (EBF) at 4 months postpartum
cohort: 80 singleton, low-risk primiparous mothers and their infants, with no history of cesarean section
finding: In low-risk primiparas, the milk production models at early postpartum and 1 month postpartum showed a high accuracy for predicting the achievement of EBF at 4 months postpartum.
